chat_commands.builtin.befehle.descriptio: Lists every available chat command, alphabetically and comma-separated.
chat_commands.builtin.discord.descriptio: Hands out the Discord link only to viewers who have followed the channel long enough.
chat_commands.builtin.discord.hint: Optionally !discord <name> can be used in chat. The sender is always the one checked – the name only changes who is addressed.
chat_commands.discord.check_failed: Hey %{user}. I could not check your follow status, try again in a moment.
chat_commands.discord.join: Hey %{user}. Come join my Discord server: %{link}
chat_commands.discord.no_user: Hey %{user}. I could not find your Twitch account.
chat_commands.discord.not_configured: Hey %{user}. The Discord command has not been set up yet.
chat_commands.discord.not_following: Hey %{user}. You have to follow %{channel} for at least %{days} days.
chat_commands.discord.too_recent: Hey %{user}. You have to follow %{channel} for at least %{days} days. %{remaining} more to go.
chat_commands.error.bad_name: A command name may only contain lowercase letters, digits, hyphen and underscore.
chat_commands.error.builtin_name: !%{name} is a basic command and cannot be overridden.
chat_commands.error.empty_response: Without a reply text there is nothing to write.
chat_commands.error.too_many: More than %{max} custom commands get unwieldy – and !befehle unreadably long.
chat_commands.field.name: Command without !
chat_commands.name: Chat commands
chat_commands.none: No custom commands have been created yet.
chat_commands.perm.custom_edit: may create, change and delete custom commands.
